title: What is Flourish?
content: Flourish is a data visualisation and storytelling platform that lets you create charts, maps, and interactive stories from your own data.

title: Who is Flourish for?
content: Journalists, data analysts, marketers, and anyone who wants to communicate clearly with data — no coding required.

title: How do I add my own data?
content: Click the Data tab in the editor, paste or upload a spreadsheet, and bind the columns to the Title and Content fields in the right-hand panel.

title: Can I embed a Flourish visual?
content: Yes — every published Flourish visualisation has an embed code you can paste into any web page or CMS.
